name: canvas
title: Canvas
description: An infinite, pannable, zoomable surface on UI SDK's viewport: scroll to pan, pinch or ⌘-scroll to zoom, Space to drag the view, zoom and arrow keys with announcements, focus and find in page brought into view, a controller to fit and zoom from outside, a dotted or ruled background that follows the view, and pointer events handed to you in board coordinates. With selection outlines, resize and rotate handles, a marquee, alignment guides and a minimap that keep their thickness at any zoom, and the frame math (hit tests, resize, rotate, snap) as plain functions.
